content.overview: Canonical source-derived learning unit: The Wonderful World of Science.
source_grounded_key_points: We start exploring our surroundings and asking questions right from our childhood.
Did you enjoy discovering and exploring the world around you in the Preparatory Stage of school?
As you enter the Middle Stage, we will continue this fascinating journey, trying to explore and understand the beautiful world we live in.
Science is a way of thinking, observing and What is doing things to understand the world we live in Science?
Think of it as a big adventure—we ask questions, explore the world and try to understand how things work.
For this, the most important thing is to have ‘Curiosity’, which is where the title of this book comes from.
Whether it is studying tiny grains of sand or massive mountains, a leaf of grass or a vast forest, there is always something new and exciting to discover.
Have you ever looked up at the night sky and wondered why the stars shine?
